models.admissionsInfo: The static information shown on the admissions landing page — overview, requirements, key dates, and available year groups.
models.yearGroup: A year group or class level the school accepts applications for, with an optional note about availability.
models.keyDate: An important date in the admissions calendar shown on the landing page.
models.requirement: A document or condition required to complete an application.
models.application: A submitted admissions application with personal, guardian, and school details, uploaded documents, and a current status.
models.applicationStage: A step in the application review timeline, used to show progress on the status tracker.

relationships: admissionsInfo contains many yearGroups, keyDates, and requirements
application has many applicationStages ordered by sequence

admissionsInfo.overview: We welcome applications from families who share our commitment to academic excellence and character development. Our admissions process is designed to be straightforward and transparent — we want every family to feel supported from their very first enquiry through to enrolment. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, subject to availability in the year group applied for.

requirements.label: Proof of address
requirements.note: Utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months

keyDates.label: Application Deadline
keyDates.note: Late applications considered if spaces remain

keyDates.label: Acceptance Deadline
keyDates.note: Return signed acceptance form and pay enrolment deposit

schoolDetails.reasonForTransfer: Seeking a school with stronger academic rigour and more extracurricular opportunities for secondary education.
